worldcombat.skill.steamroller.summary: Roll yourself into a ball and flatten a whole row: whoever the ball rolls over takes crushing damage, is shoved along the roll, and may be left reeling. It leaves a pressed track in the topsoil that recovers on its own — the cheapest, shortest-cooldown form in this group. Roll in any direction.
worldcombat.skill.steamroller.use.0: Sweep a whole row of foes in one roll
worldcombat.skill.steamroller.use.1: Keep pressing the field cheaply with a short cooldown
worldcombat.skill.steamroller.descriptio: Anyone rolled over takes about %1$s physical damage; there is a %2$s chance to make them flinch for %3$s, during which they cannot start new moves or ordinary attacks, and an interruptible action already underway is cut short. The target's Defence, type and crits settle on hit.

It rolls up to %1$s blocks along the aim at %2$s blocks/tick; along the segment the body truly travels, every enemy inside its %3$s-block crush radius is struck once, and a crushed body is shoved %4$s blocks along the roll. Bodies do not stop it, so it spends its remaining travel; a solid wall or the end of the roll does.
Topsoil it passes is pressed into %1$s tread blocks that recover on their own after %2$s; stone and other unpressedable ground is left untouched, with no new pits.
worldcombat.skill.steamroller.wide.on: Wide form: crush radius x1.25, shove x1.2 and a longer tread, so a single roll covers bodies standing abreast; at the cost of roll distance x0.9, speed x0.88, single-hit power x0.94 and +6 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.steamroller.wide.off: Fast-roll form (native): rolls farther and faster with a heavier single hit, over a narrower crush.
worldcombat.skill.steamroller.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.steamroller.growth.0: From level %1$s the crush rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.steamroller.growth.1: From level %1$s the crush rises to %2$s and the flinch chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.steamroller.preference: On: crush radius x1.25, longer shove and tread, so one roll covers bodies standing abreast; at the cost of roll distance x0.9, speed x0.88, single-hit power x0.94 and +6 ticks cooldown. Off (default): fast-roll, farther, faster and heavier over a narrower crush.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Steamroller does not roll far, so a larger value often still cannot reach.
On (default): roll at the target when others stand beside it, crushing several in one pass; off: do not pass up the real threat just to line up a row, choose by threat alone.
